source.text: መኑ፡ ይሁበኒ፡ ለአዕይንትየ፡ *ከመ፡ ይኩና፡ ደመና፡ ማይ፡ ወ*አብኪ፡ ዲበክሙ፡ ወ*አንብዕ፡ እንብዕ፡ *ከመ፡ ደመና፡ ማይ፡ ወአዕርፍ፡ እምሐዘነ፡ ልብየ።

translation.text: Who will grant that my eyes become clouds of water, so that I may weep over you and shed tears like clouds of water, and rest from the sorrow of my heart?[a]

footnotes.text: The selected Ethiopic repeats the water-cloud image. Literally the opening gives to my eyes that they become clouds of water; English recasts this as grant that my eyes become without adding a fountain. The weeping verb and tears noun are distinct: actual Dillmann1865 column658 supports both; column970 supports rest and cites95:1. Column1090 treats cloud as singular/collective, not an exact cloud count. Actual1907 grammar173–174 and540–542 supports dependent subjunctives and placing a clause subject with the leading verb, with95:1 cited at542. Printed stars and raised apparatus references are edition marks, not lexical words or new manuscript evidence.

source.text: መኑ፡ ወሀበክሙ፡ *ከመ፡ ትግበሩ፡ ጽልአ፡ ወእከይ፡ ወ*ይረክብክሙ፡ ለኃጥአን፡ ዝንቱ።
source.note: Own source-first corrective-author selected-body proposal. Printed stars retained; superscripts excluded. No alternate edition substituted. Separate peer and release gates remain.

translation.text: Who granted you to practice hatred and evil? And this will overtake you, sinners.[a]

footnotes.text: Give/grant with a dependent action is retained; no noun authority or immunity is added. Hatred and evil are both present. This preserves the actual demonstrative without naming a punishment. The selected reaching/finding verb is not the earlier rough distance-root guess: actual1865 cols302–303 includes reaching, encountering and overtaking. Sinners describes the plural you already addressed, not a new recipient. No reported apparatus variant replaces the selected body.

source.text: ኢትፍርሁ፡ ጻድቃን፡ እምኃጥአን፡ እስመ፡ ካዕበ፡ ይገብአሙ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወስተ፡ *እደክሙ፡ ከመ፡ ትግበሩ፡ ለዕሌሆሙ፡ ዝንቱ፡ በከመ፡ ፈቃደክሙ።
source.note: Own source-first corrective-author selected-body proposal. Printed stars retained; superscripts excluded. No alternate edition substituted. Separate peer and release gates remain.

translation.text: Do not fear sinners, righteous ones, for God will again deliver them into your hands, so that you may do this to them according to your will.[a]

footnotes.text: Again renders the selected adverb without a date. Causative return/deliver with them, God as subject and into your hands is retained; no reciprocal fighting or named punishment is supplied. This preserves the source demonstrative; according to your will retains the final noun. Actual1865 cols1168–1170,798–799,56–58,1360–1362 supports these senses/relations; actual1907 grammar173–174,204,518 and540–542 supports prohibition, persons and purpose. The star before hands is a printed edition mark.

source.text: አሌ፡ ለክሙ፡ እለ፡ ታወግዙ፡ ግዝታት፡ ከመ፡ ኢይትፈትሑ፡ ወ*ፈውስ፡ ርኁቅ፡ እምኔክሙ፡ በእንተ፡ ኃጢአት፡ ዚአክሙ።
source.note: Corrective v2 after informed adverse feedback and personal whole-unit native/TableI/Latin/grammar reinspection. translation.text: Woe to you who utter curses so that they are not loosed, and healing is far from you because of your sin.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected body has plural curses, ግዝታት, and the plural passive ending in ኢይትፈትሑ. They are not loosed preserves that number and the negative; it does not reverse the statement into a promise of release. Actual1865 cols939–940 gives the curse/anathema noun and its plural, while1364–1365 distinguishes loosing from its passive. Actual1907 grammar194 and204 supports reflexive-passive inflection and plural-u. Healing, distant, because of your sin retain the remaining selected words; no later church procedure or additional target of the curses is imposed. Printed stars are edition marks, not translated words.

source.text: አሌ፡ ለክሙ፡ እለ፡ ትፈድዩ፡ እኩይ፡ ለቢጸክሙ፡ እስመ፡ ትትፈደዩ፡ በከመ፡ ምግባረክሙ።
source.note: Own source-first corrective-author selected-body proposal. Printed stars retained; superscripts excluded. No alternate edition substituted. Separate peer and release gates remain.

translation.text: Woe to you who repay evil to your neighbor, for you will be repaid according to your deeds.[a]

footnotes.text: Repay and be repaid express different voices of the same root. Actual1865 cols1378–1380 provides recompense and being recompensed, including95:5;539–540 supports neighbor/fellow and1165–1166 deeds/conduct. Generic singular neighbor is retained without naming an individual or counting victims. Actual1907 grammar152–153,194 and204 supports reflexive-passive and plural person; no executioner or date is added.

source.text: አሌ፡ ለክሙ፡ ለሰማዕተ፡ ሐሰት፡ ወለእለ፡ ይደልውዎ፡ ለዐመፃ፡ እስመ፡ ፍጡነ፡ ትትሐጐሉ።
